name: South Shore Art Center – Youth Education
description_short: Weekly after-school and Saturday art classes for children in grades K–8 at South Shore Art Center in Cohasset, MA. Private and semi-private Learning Labs are also offered, including private lessons for students with special needs.
refund_policy_summary: A $25 non-refundable registration fee is included in tuition. If you cancel at least ten days before a course starts, you get a refund minus the $25 fee. Visiting Artist Workshops require 30 days' cancellation notice.
special_needs_notes: Learning Lab 815 offers private lessons for students with special needs.

warnings: This page lists fall 2026 after-school art classes, not a summer camp. It has no summer 2027 camp dates or prices.

Session prices are the non-member rates. Member rates are $45 lower: $110, $180, $180, $320, $180 and $295.
Ages are given as school grades. The page also says students 15+ can enroll in adult courses.
Course 171 (Comic and Sequential Art) does not state a grade range.
